title: Enfys Nest
description: Leader of the Cloud-Riders swoop gang, Enfys Nest was secretly working to steal enough to fuel an uprising against the gangsters like Crimson Dawn who devastated peaceful planets. She was the reason Dryden Vos and his crew blew their heist on Vandor, a constant thorn in his side. Her story served as an inspiration for Han Solo, who gave up his own score of coaxium to her and her cause.
